text:
Dr.P.V.Ramesh
PFS
⇒ 161. The chief secretary spoke to me
today requesting for "immediate
clearance of the file". Mr G. Subba Rao
met me and handed over minutes of
meeting by CS dated 05 Sept '15, letter of SIEMENS
dated 21 Aug 15 and requested for release of
money as decided by CS. considering the
decisions of CS/CM, orders of CS at para 31
on page 46 be implemented.
\underline{162}. In addition go be issued establishing a
committee for monitoring the programme
with detailed TOR . Draft may please be shown
to me before issue. A copy of the entire file record be
kept. Skill development Dept Sec asked to furnish a
copy of MOV for our record. Affiliated
-. Mheendra Jacob -

*శ్రీక్రలary to Govt.
Finance Dept.
No. Dato:
3926 9/9/15*
Section Officer
Finance Department
A.P. Secretariat, Velagapudi.
AMARAVATI - 522 238.
08 Sep '15
pl
